title: Zeb Orrelios
subtitle: Rebel
description: Garazeb Orrelios, known to his friends as Zeb for short, was a member of the Lasat Honor Guard until his people were all but wiped out by the Empire. Afterward, with his traditional bo-rifle, he joined the fight against the Empire alongside Hera Syndulla and Kanan Jarrus. As the muscle of the team, he had no qualms smashing Stormtroopers, that he delighted in calling "bucketheads".
